verdict.rationale: Airwallex exposes a Card Expenses API to retrieve approved expenses and mark them 'synced' after ingestion into an ERP, a Bills API for accounts-payable, and real-time webhooks for event notifications — these are building blocks a developer could use to construct an ERP sync. However, there is no evidence of a native, pre-built bidirectional integration with named ERP systems (e.g., NetSuit, SAP, Xero) or automatic two-way journal-entry reconciliation; it requires custom engineering rather than out-of-box sync. Missing for 10: named ERP connector/integration docs, evidence of pull-back sync from ERP to Airwallex, and confirmation of automated bidirectional journal entries eliminating manual work.
